```{r}
source(here::here("00_setup.R"))
library(crqa)
```

Load cleaned dataset

```{r}
utt_partners_emotions_merged <- readRDS( here("01Data","02Derived","FINAL_utt_RQ1_emotions_merged.rds") )
```

Create dataset for children vs social partner

```{r}
crqa_all <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>% 
select(
    # identifiers
    id,
    target_child_id,
    speaker_id,
    corpus_id,
    transcript_id,
    
    # predictors
    role_category,
    target_child_age,
    target_child_sex,
    
    # outcome / exposure
    emotion_count
  )
```

```{r}

crqa_turns <- crqa_all %>%
  group_by(transcript_id) %>%
  arrange(id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%  # use your true utterance order var here
  mutate(
    speaker_category = if_else(role_category == "Target Child",
                               "Target Child Turn",
                               "Social Partner Turn"),
    new_turn = is.na(lag(speaker_category)) | speaker_category != lag(speaker_category),
    turn_id_within_transcript = cumsum(new_turn)
  ) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, turn_id_within_transcript) %>%
  summarise(
    # identifiers
    corpus_id        = first(corpus_id),
    target_child_id  = first(target_child_id),
    speaker_id       = first(speaker_id),

    # predictors
    target_child_age = first(target_child_age),
    target_child_sex = first(target_child_sex),

    # who is speaking (what you asked for)
    speaker_category = first(speaker_category),

    # turn-level emotion counts
    emotion_count_turn = sum(emotion_count, na.rm = TRUE),

    # diagnostics (optional but useful)
    n_utts_in_turn = n(),
    first_utt_id = first(id),
    last_utt_id  = last(id),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, turn_id_within_transcript)

```
